translation: And the scrotum is the place where the channels gather and travel above and below; all the six yin accumulations that were rubbed and dispersed could not pass the penis, and flowed backward and became tinea. After the penis was opened, I still made the jaw primary, as the outlet of the accumulation. I had previously heard that martial artists rub the penis to guard against kicks and blows, but I had not heard of using it to treat disease. Now for the first time I know that all diseases of the lower part can be treated; if the perineum is rubbed open, the sinews and vessels have no obstruction, disease cannot remain, and one immediately sees marvelous effect.
